execution: Runs PGD around a prepared model
hooks: Forward reads through an internal Saliency stage
effects_and_ordering: Reads targets and writes optimised inputs; internal Saliency must be installed before PGD
device_batch_gradient: Inputs and targets must share a device; gradients required; preserves TensorDict batch metadata

execution: Runs the model and differentiates selected targets
hooks: Forward reads of target activations plus gradient capture
effects_and_ordering: Read-only activations and gradients; target selection precedes attribution reduction
device_batch_gradient: Inputs, targets, and captured activations must share a device; gradients required; preserves TensorDict batch metadata

execution: Runs the model and differentiates selected targets
hooks: Forward reads plus backward writes on matched modules
effects_and_ordering: Backward hooks clamp negative gradients; registration order matters with other backward writers
device_batch_gradient: Inputs and targets must share a device; gradients required; preserves TensorDict batch metadata

execution: Runs an expanded interpolation batch and differentiates selected targets
hooks: Forward reads and optional backward-pre writes inherited from gradient attribution
effects_and_ordering: Reads baseline and targets; writes attribution; convergence delta adds endpoint evaluations
model_passes: 1 expanded call; 2 extra calls when convergence delta is enabled
required_keys: pipeline inputs/input and inputs/baseline; additional_init_keys when configured
produced_keys: pipeline attributions/values; standalone attribution_key/input; convergence_delta when enabled
device_batch_gradient: Inputs and baselines must align in shape and device; gradients required; expands the sample batch by n_steps

execution: Runs the prepared rule-mapped model and differentiates selected targets
hooks: Forward and backward behavior supplied by mapped LRP rules
effects_and_ordering: Rules rewrite propagation behavior; mapping must be installed before execution and restored afterwards
model_mutation: Temporary module replacement restored on exit
device_batch_gradient: Inputs and targets must share a device; gradients required; preserves TensorDict batch metadata

execution: Runs the model and differentiates selected targets
hooks: Forward reads and optional backward-pre writes
effects_and_ordering: Read-only unless output_grad_callbacks write gradients; writer order must be declared
device_batch_gradient: Inputs and targets must share a device; gradients required; preserves TensorDict batch metadata

execution: Runs positive and negative examples to derive a vector
effects_and_ordering: Reads both source runs and writes steer artifacts after both complete
specialisation: Wrapper-relative path and shared cache reference
device_batch_gradient: Positive and negative batches must be compatible; cache and model tensors must share a device; no gradients required

execution: Runs the model while copying selected activations or gradients to context cache
hooks: Configured forward or backward hook directions
effects_and_ordering: Read-only hook effects; cache keys are direction-qualified when multiple directions are used
device_batch_gradient: Cached values retain source device and shape; backward directions require gradients

execution: Runs a clean input and a patched input
hooks: Forward read followed by prepended forward write
effects_and_ordering: Clean activation must be cached before the patched pass; patch write is prepended
specialisation: Wrapper-relative path and shared cache reference
device_batch_gradient: Clean and patched inputs and activations must be shape/device compatible; no gradients required

execution: Runs the model and dispatches selected activations to probes
hooks: Configured forward or backward read directions; optional root forward-pre read
effects_and_ordering: Read-only model hooks; compatible ProbingStage instances may share one ordered HookGroup run
required_keys: pipeline inputs/input; configured additional_keys such as labels and step_type
produced_keys: pipeline probes/results; standalone manager estimator and metric state
device_batch_gradient: Activation, label, and estimator devices must be compatible; backward directions require gradients; probe preprocessing controls batch flattening

execution: Runs the model with activation edits
effects_and_ordering: Writers run in registration order; later readers observe the value returned by earlier writers
device_batch_gradient: steer_fn output must match activation shape/device/dtype; gradients optional

execution: Transforms an existing representation TensorDict; no model execution
effects_and_ordering: Reads one key and writes one key
device_batch_gradient: Input shape (..., N, D); PCA copies neighborhoods to CPU and results return to the input device; gradients are not preserved

execution: Transforms an existing representation TensorDict; no model execution
effects_and_ordering: Reads one key and writes one key
device_batch_gradient: Input shape (..., N, D); runs on the input device; no gradient contract

execution: Transforms an existing representation TensorDict; no model execution
effects_and_ordering: Reads one key and writes one key
device_batch_gradient: Input shape (..., N, D); PCA copies neighborhoods to CPU and results return to the input device; gradients are not preserved

execution: Transforms an existing representation TensorDict; no model execution
effects_and_ordering: Reads one key and writes one or three keys
device_batch_gradient: Input shape (..., N, D); runs on the input device; no gradient contract

execution: Transforms two existing representation artifacts; no model execution
effects_and_ordering: Reads two keys and writes one key
device_batch_gradient: Inputs require matching batch shape, sample count, and device; no gradient contract

execution: Transforms two existing representation artifacts; no model execution
effects_and_ordering: Reads two keys and writes two directional keys
device_batch_gradient: Inputs require matching batch shape, sample count, and device; no gradient contract

execution: Runs the model with adapter-defined activation edits
hooks: Configured forward or backward reads and writes
effects_and_ordering: Source reads must precede destination writes; adapter return replaces destination activation
produced_keys: pipeline outputs/model; standalone model outputs and optional context cache
model_mutation: Adapter parameters may be stateful; base weights are not replaced
device_batch_gradient: Adapter input/output must match target activation device/shape; backward directions require gradients

execution: Mutates weights on context entry and then runs the model
effects_and_ordering: Pruning is applied before execution and original weights are restored on context exit
required_keys: model inputs; importance_callback inputs from parameters
device_batch_gradient: Importance scores must match parameter device/shape; model batch contract is unchanged; gradients optional

execution: Prepares weight vectors; evaluation count is controlled by alpha search callbacks
effects_and_ordering: Vectors are applied inside a scoped context; alpha candidates are evaluated in iterable order
model_passes: 0 during prepare; callback-defined and potentially unbounded during alpha selection
required_keys: finetuned module or vectors supplied through TaskVectorsModule methods
produced_keys: task vectors; forget vectors; candidate weights
specialisation: Shared TensorDict state runtime plus TaskVectorsContext and TaskVectorsModule
device_batch_gradient: Vector keys/shapes/devices must match model parameters; both evaluation callbacks must declare their own pass, batch, device, and gradient budgets

execution: Consumes two captured activations inside Probing
effects_and_ordering: Caches the first activation until its pair arrives; fit mutates estimator state
device_batch_gradient: Inputs and estimator device/batch requirements must agree

execution: Builds and owns BilinearProbe instances
effects_and_ordering: One stable probe per key pair and direction; overwrite_results controls repeated metrics
required_keys: pair configuration; estimator factory; metric callback
device_batch_gradient: Delegates device/batch/gradient requirements to probes and estimators

execution: Fits or predicts from one captured activation
effects_and_ordering: fit updates parameters; predict is read-only
required_keys: one activation tensor; labels for fit
device_batch_gradient: Estimator and tensors must be on compatible devices; fit uses gradients internally

execution: Fits or predicts from two captured activations
effects_and_ordering: fit updates parameters; predict is read-only
required_keys: two activation tensors; labels for fit
device_batch_gradient: Estimator and tensors must be on compatible devices; fit uses gradients internally

execution: Fits or predicts from one NumPy-like activation array
effects_and_ordering: fit replaces coefficient and intercept state
required_keys: one activation array; binary labels for fit
device_batch_gradient: CPU/NumPy operator; caller controls batch conversion; no autograd

execution: Consumes one captured activation inside Probing
effects_and_ordering: fit mutates estimator state; predict invokes the metric callback
device_batch_gradient: Delegates device/batch/gradient requirements to the estimator

execution: Builds and owns Probe instances
effects_and_ordering: One probe per key and direction; overwrite policy controls repeated runs
device_batch_gradient: Delegates device/batch/gradient requirements to probes and estimators
